verdict.rationale: Mercury advertises earning up to 3.89% yield through Treasury by Mercury Advisory alongside its checking and savings accounts. Its API supports internal transfers between depository and treasury/investment accounts within the same organization, plus treasury transaction and statement endpoints, so idle cash can earn yield without leaving Mercury. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on how Treasury works (liquidity, sweep from operating, rate conditions behind "up to"), any stated yield on the operating or savings balances themselves, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
